cli.help:
Dracosh: a vocabulary and quiz trainer for your terminal

Usage: dracosh [options]
       dracosh restore [number]   list your backups, or bring one back

  --deck <name>    quiz this deck, this run only (otherwise the one picked in /decks)
  --every <time>   pause between questions: 30s, 10m, 1h (default: {interval})
  --no-sound       turn sound effects off
  --volume <0-1>   sound volume (default: {volume})
  --stats          print progress and exit
  --data           show where your cards, progress and backups are kept
  --preview        browse every animation and screen on made-up data (nothing is saved)
  -y, --yes        restore without asking first
  -h, --help       show this help

Flags override your saved settings for this run only. Change the saved ones with /settings.

While running: Enter submits (with nothing typed it shows the answer, then 1 or 2), "/" opens the command menu (/add, /decks, /settings, /stats, /help…),
Esc quits (clears the line first if you typed something). Ctrl+C also works.
Between cards: Enter asks the next one right away, q quits. /help explains the rest.
cli.badVolume: Invalid --volume "{value}". Use a number from 0 to 1.
cli.cantUseFolder: Dracosh can't use {home} for its data ({code}). Point DRACOSH_HOME at a folder you can write to.

data.state: state.json     progress, streak and badges: {count} practised{missing}
data.footer: To keep it somewhere else (a synced folder, say), set DRACOSH_HOME. dracosh restore brings a backup back.

restore.none: No backups yet. Dracosh makes one every day you use it, in {dir}
restore.howTo: Bring one back with: dracosh restore <number>
restore.noSuch: There's no backup number {number}. Run "dracosh restore" to see the list.
restore.bringsBack: This brings back your {what} from the backup of {time}.
restore.undo: What you have now is backed up first, so you can undo this.
restore.needsYes: Add --yes to restore without a prompt.

keys-enter.text: Don't want to wait? Press Enter between cards and the next one comes right away.

keys-esc.text: Esc clears what you typed. Press it twice on an empty line to quit.

keys-wake.text: Leave Dracosh alone for a few minutes and your dragon dozes off. Any key wakes it.

keys-filter.text: Type / and a letter or two to narrow the commands: /pa finds /pause.

cards-decks.text: /decks switches to another deck or starts a new one. Dracosh opens that deck next time too.

cards-add.text: /add puts new cards into the deck you're practising. Esc when you're done.

cards-typo.text: One wrong letter in a longer word still counts as right. Dracosh shows you the correct spelling.

cards-boxes.text: A right answer sends a card to a later box: it comes back in 1, 3, 7, 14, then 30 days.

cards-miss.text: A missed card goes back to the first box and comes back within minutes, until it sticks.

cards-hint.text: Stuck on a card? /hint reveals one more letter. The card still counts, but stays in its box.

cards-correct.text: Marked wrong although you were right? Type /correct before the next card and it counts.

cards-dont-know.text: Don't know it? Press Enter with nothing typed, look, then 1 if you didn't know it or 2 if you did.

cards-missed.text: /missed lists the cards you got wrong today. Use ← and → to look at earlier days.

cards-new.text: Dracosh mixes new cards in with your reviews, up to 20 new ones a day.

streak-goal.text: Reach your daily goal to keep your streak going. You can change the goal in /settings.

streak-freeze.text: A freeze saves your streak on a day you missed. You start with two and get one back each week.

streak-weekends.text: Weekends are rest days by default: skipping them never breaks your streak. Change it in /settings.

streak-days-off.text: Going away? /pause 7d keeps your streak safe for a week. /pause 24.12 2.01 takes dates.

streak-stats.text: /stats shows your streak and a calendar of the month. Use ← and → to see other months.

dragon-forms.text: Your dragon grows with your best streak: a new form at 7, 30, 90, 180 and 365 days.

dragon-companion.text: /companion shows your dragon and the forms still ahead of it.

dragon-combo.text: Three right answers in a row and your dragon starts to glow. Keep the combo going!

dragon-badges.text: /badges shows every badge and what unlocks it. One of them stays secret until you win it.

pause-break.text: Need some focus? /pause 30m or /pause 2h holds the cards. /pause off brings them back.

pause-quiet.text: Set quiet hours in /settings and Dracosh stays silent while you sleep.

settings-every.text: Cards too often, or not often enough? Change the interval in /settings.

settings-sound.text: Sound and volume are in /settings, along with quiet hours for the evening.

data-backup.text: Dracosh backs up your cards and progress every day. dracosh restore brings a backup back.

cards-line.text: In /add one line makes a card: kot = cat; kitty. The ; separates right answers, // adds an example.

cards-paste.text: Paste a whole list into /add, one card per line. You check it before anything is saved.

cards-cloze.text: In /add, braces make a gap: I {{look forward}} to it. In the quiz you type only the gap.

cards-direction.text: A deck can be asked front to back, back to front or both ways. /decks, then → changes it.

settings-rhythm.text: Want to study in one go? Set the rhythm to session in /settings: Enter brings the next card.

cards.front: Welcome! Every few minutes a card asks you something. Type the answer and press Enter. Try it and type `hello`
cards.example: Press `Enter` now for the next card, or wait and it will come by itself.

cards.front: Small typos still count. Type `dragon`, but miss a letter on purpose (like `dragn`)
cards.example: A typo counts as right, and Dracosh shows you the correct spelling.

cards.front: A card can accept more than one answer. What is 2 + 2? (`4` and `four` both work)
cards.example: Every right answer moves a card to a later box, so you see it less and less often.

cards.front: Stuck? Type `/hint` and press Enter, and the answer shows up letter by letter. Try it, then type `apple`
cards.example: A hinted answer still counts, but the card stays in its box for now.

cards.front: What is your dragon's secret name? Nobody knows, so get this one wrong on purpose and type `dog`
cards.example: In your own decks a missed card comes back sooner. If you were marked wrong by mistake, type `/correct` now.

cards.front: Don't know an answer? Press Enter with nothing typed: the answer shows up, and you press 2 if you knew it or 1 if you didn't. Try it, or type `show`
cards.example: Grade yourself honestly: it decides when a card comes back. Whole sentences are easiest this way.

cards.front: Type `/` at any time to see all commands. Try `/badges` after this card. For now, type `ok`
cards.example: `/stats` shows your calendar, `/companion` your dragon, `/settings` how often cards come.

cards.front: Reach your daily goal every day to keep your streak. Your dragon grows with it. Type `every day`
cards.example: Miss a day and a freeze saves your streak, if you have one left.

cards.front: Need a break? `/pause 1h` holds the cards for an hour, `/pause 3d` gives you days off. For now, type `later`
cards.example: Leave Dracosh alone for a few minutes and the dragon dozes off. Any key wakes it.
Now make it yours and type `/add` to start your own deck. The tour makes room for it.
